title: [Feature/UI]: CSS Glassmorphism & Neon HUD Reticle Customizer for Arcade Cabinets
body:
## Problem
First-person and top-down shooter games in ArcadeVerse currently use basic browser mouse cursors or static PNG crosshairs that cannot be customized for visibility, color contrast, or playstyle.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Interactive Reticle Studio (`assets/js/glassmorphism-reticle.js`):**
   - A standalone developer and player studio modal for authoring custom animated neon HUD aiming reticles.
   - Reticle components: center dot, dynamic spreading crossbars, rotating radial dial rings, and distance telemetry notches.
2. **Dynamic Recoil Spread & Firing Bloom:**
   - Reticle crossbars dynamically expand on mouse fire/movement and recover with spring damping based on custom game events.
3. **CSS Backdrop Blur Glassmorphic Frames:**
   - Surrounds HUD widgets with frosted glassmorphism containers (`backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`) with neon border glows.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60 FPS reticle tracking with sub-pixel canvas rendering.
- [ ] 1-click JSON reticle preset export and persistence in `localStorage`.
- [ ] Fully accessible with high-contrast color accessibility options.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Web Audio Dynamic Comb Filter & Flanger/Phaser Effect DSP Node
body:
## Problem
Sci-fi lasers, jet thrusters, and hyperspace warp moments sound generic when restricted to basic oscillator tones. Vintage arcade sound chips created signature swooshing sounds by passing audio through analogue bucket-brigade delay lines.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Variable Delay-Line Flanger & Comb Filter (`assets/js/audio-flanger-comb.js`):**
   - Implements modulated short delay lines (0.5ms to 15ms) using `DelayNode` and feedback gain loops with an integrated LFO.
   - Induces destructive and constructive interference, creating sweeping harmonic notches (the iconic 'jet plane' flanging effect).
2. **Multi-Stage Phaser All-Pass Filter Bank:**
   - 4-stage and 8-stage cascaded `BiquadFilterNode` all-pass filters sweeping phase relationships across the spectrum.
3. **Audio Subsystem Insertion:**
   - Exposes `ArcadeVerse.audio.applyFlanger(sourceNode, { depth, speed, feedback })`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Authentic retro flanging and comb filtering with zero audio crackling.
- [ ] Clean parameter automation using Web Audio `AudioParam` timeline events.
- [ ] Tested and verified across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari audio backends.

title: [Feature/Canvas]: Dynamic Canvas Procedural Lightning & Electric Arc Plasma Discharger
body:
## Problem
Electricity, Tesla coils, and plasma weapon effects in arcade games are currently drawn as straight colored lines or pre-baked sprite loops that repeat predictably without dynamic crackle.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Midpoint-Displacement Fractal Lightning (`assets/js/plasma-lightning.js`):**
   - Implements recursive midpoint displacement with randomized perpendicular offsets to generate chaotic, branching electric arcs between arbitrary endpoints $(x_1, y_1) 	o (x_2, y_2)$.
2. **Sub-Branch Forking & Pulsating Alpha Glows:**
   - Generates secondary fork branches that taper in width and intensity, flickering with randomized frame life and multi-layered neon glow shadows.
3. **Interactive Target Zapping:**
   - Electric arcs automatically seek and leap between nearby interactive canvas game entities (enemies, metal obstacles, power coils).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generates and renders 10+ active branching lightning bolts at solid 60 FPS.
- [ ] Pure Canvas 2D path rendering without static image assets.
- [ ] Helper method `ArcadeVerse.vfx.zap(startX, startY, targetX, targetY, options)`.

title: [Feature/Gameplay]: Client-Side Bookmarkable Challenge Run Modifier Engine
body:
## Problem
Replaying arcade games can become repetitive once a player masters the base difficulty. Players have no built-in way to create custom challenge runs (like 'Sudden Death', 'Inverted Controls', or 'Turbo Speed') to challenge friends.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Universal Game Modifier System (`assets/js/challenge-modifiers.js`):**
   - An accessible drawer in the game modal offering standardized gameplay mutators: `Sudden Death (1 HP)`, `Low Gravity (0.5x)`, `Turbo Clock (1.5x)`, `Inverted Steer`, and `Foggy Darkness`.
2. **Deterministic Mutator Bitmask & Base64 URL Encoding:**
   - Encodes active challenge modifiers into a compact URL parameter string with 1-click shareable links.
3. **Challenge Run Leaderboard Verification Tag:**
   - Submits game scores with verified challenge badges so high scores achieved under extreme handicaps are highlighted on the podium.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Seamlessly applies global input/speed modifiers to games via the client SDK.
- [ ] Generates instant shareable URLs with 1-click copy to clipboard.
- [ ] Non-intrusive modal UI that stays hidden during standard play.

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Canvas 2D Convex Hull & Minimum Bounding Box Collision Calculator
body:
## Problem
Many arcade games in the catalog use rough rectangular bounding boxes `(x, y, w, h)` for irregularly shaped polygon sprites (spaceships, asteroids, curved swords), resulting in frustrating 'phantom hits' where bullets register hits on empty air.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Convex Hull Point-Set Reducer (`assets/js/convex-hull-collision.js`):**
   - Implements Graham Scan or Monotone Chain algorithms to automatically compute tight convex polygon boundaries around arbitrary vertex clusters in $O(n \log n)$ time.
2. **Separating Axis Theorem (SAT) Collision Solver:**
   - Implements SAT projection calculations for arbitrary convex polygons, computing exact intersection booleans, minimum translation vectors (MTV), and collision contact normals.
3. **Visual Debug Collision Overlay:**
   - Developer mode toggle rendering brightly colored wireframe convex hulls and penetration normal vectors in real time.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sub-millisecond SAT collision resolution for 50+ simultaneous moving polygon pairs.
- [ ] Accurate calculation of Minimum Translation Vectors for realistic physics bounces.
- [ ] Fully tested against edge cases (parallel edges, overlapping vertices).

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Interactive Pixel-Art Glyph Matrix & Custom Bitmap Font Renderer
body:
## Problem
Loading web fonts (TTF/WOFF) inside game canvas elements causes Flash of Unstyled Text (FOUT), blurriness when scaled at integer pixel ratios, and external network dependency issues.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **64-Bit Bitmask Micro-Font Engine (`assets/js/bitmap-font-renderer.js`):**
   - Encodes complete ASCII and retro symbol sets into high-density 3x5 and 5x5 binary bitmasks stored directly in pure JavaScript arrays.
2. **Sub-Pixel Integer Canvas Blitter:**
   - Renders razor-sharp pixel text onto game canvases with customizable integer scaling factors (1x, 2x, 4x), custom drop shadows, and neon rainbow gradient fills.
3. **Specialty Arcade Glyphs & Icons:**
   - Includes built-in retro arcade icon glyphs: heart icons, coins, skulls, arrows, and gamepad buttons mapped to ASCII escape sequences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 100% offline, zero-dependency pixel typography with zero font loading delays.
- [ ] Renders thousands of characters per frame with under 0.5ms draw call overhead.
- [ ] Simple API `ArcadeVerse.ui.drawPixelText(ctx, "HIGH SCORE: 9999", x, y, options)`.

title: [Feature/VFX]: Dynamic Canvas Particle Text Dissolve & Matrix Digit Rain Transition
body:
## Problem
Game Over, Stage Clear, and Victory banners currently appear and disappear with abrupt CSS opacity cuts or static text displays, missing the visual drama of physical retro arcade transition effects.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Canvas Raster Text Particle Slicer (`assets/js/particle-text-dissolve.js`):**
   - Renders text offscreen, extracts active non-transparent pixels via `ctx.getImageData()`, and instantiates an object-pooled swarm of physical pixel particles.
2. **Configurable Transition Physics Modes:**
   - `Vortex Dissolve` (particles swirl outward in radial turbulent vortexes), `Gravitational Fall` (letters crumble like breaking sandstone bricks), and `Matrix Code Rain` (vertical glowing glyph cascades).
3. **Reversible Assembly Animation:**
   - Supports reversing the particle animation to assemble glowing text out of floating cosmic dust.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60 FPS particle transition without frame drops or memory leaks.
- [ ] Reusable transition trigger `ArcadeVerse.vfx.dissolveText(text, x, y, options)`.
- [ ] Automatic fallback to simple fade when `prefers-reduced-motion` is active.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Web Audio Binaural Beat & Isochronic Tone Brainwave Synchronizer
body:
## Problem
During long arcade marathon sessions and competitive tournament play, players can experience fatigue or tension. Retro arcade hubs historically used hypnotic ambient drones to induce a flow state.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Binaural Frequency Offset Synthesizer (`assets/js/binaural-brainwave.js`):**
   - Generates precision frequency pairs through separate left and right stereo channels using Web Audio oscillators (e.g. 432 Hz Left, 442 Hz Right $	o$ 10 Hz Alpha wave).
2. **Isochronic Pulse Modulation:**
   - For speaker listening (where stereo binaural separation is absent), provides isochronic tones using sharp rhythmic gain pulsing at target brainwave frequencies (Alpha: 8-12Hz for calm focus, Beta: 13-30Hz for high alertness).
3. **Subtle Background Ambience Blending:**
   - Blends beneath game music at a customizable low volume (-24dB) so it remains relaxing without overpowering sound effects.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] High-precision frequency accuracy within 0.1 Hz using Web Audio native nodes.
- [ ] User toggle switch in hub audio settings with volume fader.
- [ ] Complete documentation explaining psychoacoustic principles on `ideas.html`.

title: [Feature/Physics]: Dynamic 2D Cloth & Cape Verlet Physics Drape Simulation Engine
body:
## Problem
Characters in platformers, wizard duels, and superhero arcade games currently have rigid rectangular capes or static sprites that remain stiff while jumping, falling, or running.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Verlet Numerical Particle Cloth Grid (`assets/js/verlet-chainmail.js`):**
   - Implements a 2D particle constraint grid (e.g. 8x12 linked particles) governed by Verlet integration, gravity vectors, and distance relaxation constraints.
2. **Dynamic Aerodynamic Drag & Wind Turbulence:**
   - Applies aerodynamic drag based on character horizontal velocity so capes billow backward when sprinting, flap upwards during falls, and ripple in ambient breeze.
3. **Textured Bezier Quad Skinning:**
   - Renders the cloth using smooth curved Bezier ribbons with dynamic neon edge stitching and shading highlights.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stable 60 FPS cape simulation without constraint snapping or knotting.
- [ ] Interactive wind and mouse interaction testing sandbox.
- [ ] Lightweight helper `ArcadeVerse.physics.createCape(anchorEntity, options)`.

title: [Feature/Shaders]: Dynamic Canvas Heat Distortion & Thermal Mirage Air Shimmer Filter
body:
## Problem
Lava worlds, desert tracks, and rocket thruster exhausts in arcade games lack the intense physical sensation of extreme heat because scenes remain static without optical air shimmering.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Sinusoidal Scanline Displacement Mapper (`assets/js/thermal-heat-shimmer.js`):**
   - Implements an analytical thermal mirage algorithm displacing canvas horizontal scanlines with phase-offset sinusoidal waves $(dx = A \cdot \sin(\omega y + \phi t))$.
2. **Localized Heat Emitter Bounds:**
   - Allows confining the shimmer effect to localized bounding boxes (above a lava pit, behind a jet spaceship engine, or over a campfire) rather than distorting the entire screen.
3. **High-Performance Clamped Buffer Processing:**
   - Uses direct `Uint32Array` scanline pointer shifts on a temporary canvas frame to ensure zero performance overhead on mobile and low-end hardware.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Convincing thermal heat shimmer effect executing in under 2ms per frame.
- [ ] Pure Canvas 2D math without WebGL or shader extensions.
- [ ] Clean API `ArcadeVerse.vfx.createHeatZone(x, y, width, height, intensity)`.
